notes: Release gate for P39, which re-partitioned skills/work/SKILL.md and its reference: the argument moved to an uncited docs/research file, the three routing cases returned to the body, the reference kept only the transition line. 11,245 -> 6,241 B per invocation.

TWO suites were run, not one, because work's own evals do not grade what this diff moved. work eval 1's workdir is not a git repository, so its commit path is exercised only as 'fail-open, reported once' and no commit, transition line or route is ever asserted. loop eval 1 is the suite that grades those.
Counts are the graders' own PASS:/FAIL: lines.

Deviation recorded rather than glossed: the executor reported that the Task tool was unavailable in its context, so it ran the review lens inline instead of dispatching reviewer-* subagents. Same caveat class as P31/P32 — this run measures inline review, not fan-out. It does not touch the assertions this gate turns on (telemetry, commits, behaviour).

The run surfaced a real domain finding it logged as a follow-up rather than fixing: add_stock appends duplicates, so restock fans out across every matching row. That is fixture behaviour, not a skill defect, and the grader does not assert on it.
